rows.input: with picked as (select id from t where active), vals as (select id,2 as n from picked) update t set n=vals.n from vals where t.id=vals.id returning t.id;
rows.trimmed: with picked as (select id from t where active), vals as (select id,2 as n from picked) update t set n=vals.n from vals where t.id=vals.id returning t.id;

expect.output:
WITH
    picked AS (
        SELECT
            id
        FROM
            t
        WHERE
            active
    ),
    vals AS (
        SELECT
            id,
            2 AS n
        FROM
            picked
    )
UPDATE t
SET
    n = vals.n
FROM
    vals
WHERE
    t.id = vals.id
RETURNING
    t.id;
